name: original
description: 29 answerable + 6 unanswerable. q01-q20 written mostly from the v6/v7 migration guides; q21-q35 from the regular docs (MCP, chat persistence, embeddings, tools). 'must_include' = identifiers a correct answer should contain (cheap string check). 'evidence' = facts needed to answer; each fact is a list of terms that must all appear in one retrieved chunk ('a|b' = either), used for retrieval scoring. 'stale_signals' = outdated v5/v6 APIs; if the answer RECOMMENDS one of these, it's wrong (mentioning it as deprecated is fine), so grade those with the LLM judge, not string match.

items.input: In the current AI SDK, how do I pass a system prompt to generateText?
reference: Use the top-level `instructions` option
`system` still works as a deprecated fallback
If both are set, `instructions` takes precedence

items.input: After upgrading, my generateText call fails when my messages array contains a { role: 'system' } message loaded from my database. Why, and how do I fix it?
reference: AI SDK 7 rejects system messages in `prompt`/`messages` by default
Preferred fix: move them to the top-level `instructions` option
For trusted persisted chats, set `allowSystemInMessages: true`
Never enable it for user-editable messages (prompt injection risk)

sources.section: Prompt Messages: System Messages in `prompt` or `messages` Are Rejected by Default

items.input: What Node.js version does the AI SDK require, and can I still import it with require()?
reference: Node.js 22 or later (tested on 22, 24, 26); 18 and 20 unsupported
Packages are ESM-only; require() is not supported
Add "type": "module" to package.json or use .mjs files

sources.section: Minimum Node.js Version / ESM Only — CommonJS Support Removed

items.input: How do I stop a multi-step tool-calling loop after 5 steps?
reference: Set `stopWhen: isStepCount(5)`
`stepCountIs` was renamed to `isStepCount` in v7

items.input: What class do I use to build a tool-using agent, and how many steps does it run by default?
reference: `ToolLoopAgent` (replaced `Experimental_Agent`)
Default `stopWhen` is `isStepCount(20)`
Agent instructions go in `instructions`, not `system`

items.input: How do I get a typed object that matches a Zod schema from the model?
reference: Call `generateText` with `output: Output.object({ schema })`
Read the result from `result.output`
`generateObject` is deprecated; `experimental_output` was removed in v7

sources.section: Structured Outputs: Remove Deprecated `experimental_output` Option and Result

items.input: How do I stream a structured object so the UI can render it while it's being generated?
reference: Use `streamText` with `output: Output.object({ schema })`
Iterate `partialOutputStream` with for await
`streamObject` / `partialObjectStream` are the deprecated approach

items.input: In a multi-step generateText call, does result.usage cover only the last step or all steps? How do I get the other one?
reference: `result.usage` is total usage across all steps
`result.finalStep.usage` gives only the final step
`totalUsage` is deprecated

items.input: After a multi-step tool call, how do I get the full list of assistant and tool messages to save to my database?
reference: Use `result.responseMessages`
`step.response.messages` now only contains that step's messages (no longer accumulated)
Alternative: `result.steps.flatMap(step => step.response.messages)`

sources.section: Step Response Messages Are No Longer Accumulated

items.input: How do I iterate over every event from streamText, including text deltas and tool calls?
reference: Iterate `result.stream` with for await
`fullStream` was renamed to `stream` (kept as a deprecated alias)

items.input: How do I return a UI message stream from my API route so useChat can consume it?
reference: Build it with the top-level `toUIMessageStream({ stream: result.stream, ... })`
Return `createUIMessageStreamResponse({ stream: uiStream })`
`result.toUIMessageStreamResponse()` still works but is deprecated

sources.section: `streamText` Response Helpers Deprecated — Use Stateless Helpers

items.input: How do I make a deleteFile tool require user approval before it executes?
reference: Set `toolApproval` on the generateText/streamText call or the agent
e.g. `toolApproval: { deleteFile: 'user-approval' }`, or a function returning 'user-approval' / undefined
`needsApproval` on tool() is deprecated for generateText/streamText/ToolLoopAgent; it is still how approval is set with WorkflowAgent

items.input: How do I pass an API key into a tool's execute function at call time instead of hardcoding it?
reference: Declare `contextSchema` on the tool
Pass values via `toolsContext`, keyed by tool name
Read it in execute as `{ context }` (typed from the schema)
Shared, non-tool state goes in `runtimeContext`; `experimental_context` was renamed

sources.section: Context: `experimental_context` Became Tool `context`, and Shared Runtime Data Moved to `runtimeContext`

items.input: How do I enable OpenTelemetry tracing for all AI SDK calls?
reference: Install `@ai-sdk/otel`
Call `registerTelemetry(new OpenTelemetry())` once at startup
Telemetry is then on by default; opt out per call with `isEnabled: false`
The option is now `telemetry` (`experimental_telemetry` is a deprecated alias)

items.input: How do I read how many input tokens were served from the prompt cache?
reference: `result.usage.inputTokenDetails.cacheReadTokens`
Cache writes: `inputTokenDetails.cacheWriteTokens`
Top-level `cachedInputTokens` was removed in v7

items.input: How do I create an OpenAI embedding model and embed a single string?
reference: `openai.embeddingModel('text-embedding-3-small')` or shorthand `openai.embedding(...)`
Pass it to `embed({ model, value })`
`textEmbeddingModel` / `textEmbedding` are the old names
A model id string like 'openai/text-embedding-3-small' also works

items.input: When will AI SDK 8 be released?
reference: The docs don't say; the bot should state that and not guess a date

items.input: On what date will generateObject be fully removed?
reference: Docs only say it will be removed in a future version; no date given. The bot may mention the Output replacement but must not invent a date or version number

items.input: What are the AI SDK's built-in default rate limits per API key?
reference: Not in the docs; rate limits come from the model provider. The bot should say it can't find this rather than invent numbers

items.input: How many weekly npm downloads does the ai package have?
reference: Out of scope for the docs; the bot should decline and not produce a number

items.input: How do I connect to a remote MCP server over HTTP and let streamText use its tools?
reference: Create a client with `createMCPClient` from `@ai-sdk/mcp`, e.g. `transport: { type: 'http', url }`
Get the tools with `await mcpClient.tools()` and pass them as `tools`
Close the client when done, e.g. `await mcpClient.close()` in streamText's `onEnd`
stdio transport is for local servers only, not production

sources.section: Initializing an MCP Client / Closing the MCP Client

items.input: My MCP server marks a tool with destructiveHint: true. Will the AI SDK automatically ask the user for approval before running it?
reference: No: annotations are untrusted, server-provided hints and the MCP client does not turn them into an approval policy
They are exposed on the tool's `metadata.annotations` and the tool call's `toolMetadata.annotations`
Write your own `toolApproval` policy, e.g. return 'user-approval' unless `readOnlyHint === true`

items.input: MCP tool calls sometimes fail with rate limits or gateway timeouts. Can the MCP client retry them automatically?
reference: Yes, opt in with `maxRetries` on `createMCPClient` (e.g. `maxRetries: 2`)
Retries are disabled by default
They apply to `tools/call` requests

items.input: In my useChat API route, how do I save the full conversation, including the new AI response, once streaming finishes?
reference: Use `toUIMessageStream({ stream: result.stream, originalMessages: messages, onEnd: ({ messages }) => saveChat(...) })`
`onEnd` receives the complete `UIMessage[]` including the new response
Return it with `createUIMessageStreamResponse({ stream })`
Store messages in the `UIMessage` (useChat) format

items.input: If the user closes the browser tab while the response is still streaming, the answer never gets saved. How do I fix that?
reference: Call `result.consumeStream()` (without await) before returning the response
It removes backpressure, so the stream runs to completion and `onEnd` still fires and saves the chat
For more robust handling, use resumable streams

items.input: Should I store chat messages in my database as ModelMessage or UIMessage, and what should I do when I load them back?
reference: Store them as `UIMessage` (the useChat format, with fields like `id`)
Validate loaded messages that contain tools, metadata or data parts with `validateUIMessages`
Convert them with `convertToModelMessages` before passing them to the model

sources.section: Storing messages / Validating messages on the server

items.input: I need to embed thousands of document chunks for RAG. How do I embed them in bulk while limiting how many requests run at once?
reference: Use `embedMany({ model, values })`; embeddings come back in the same order as the values
Limit concurrency with `maxParallelCalls`
embedMany splits large inputs into multiple model calls

items.input: How do I request smaller embedding vectors, for example 512 dimensions?
reference: Pass the top-level `dimensions: 512` option to `embed` or `embedMany`
A dimension setting in `providerOptions` takes precedence over `dimensions`
Support and allowed values depend on the model; the SDK does not truncate or resize vectors

items.input: How do I compare two embeddings to see how similar they are?
reference: Use `cosineSimilarity(a, b)` exported from `ai`

items.input: The model calls two tools in one step, but the second one must see the side effects of the first. How do I make tool calls run one at a time?
reference: Set `toolCallConcurrency: 1` (by default tool calls in a step run concurrently)
Calls then start sequentially in the order the model generated them
It does not change how many tool calls the model generates; provider options like `parallelToolCalls` control that

items.input: How do I force the model to call one specific tool?
reference: Set `toolChoice: { type: 'tool', toolName: '<name>' }`
`'required'` forces some tool, `'none'` forbids tools, `'auto'` is the default

items.input: When my tool's execute function throws an error, does generateText throw too? How do I find out which tool failed?
reference: No: tool execution errors become `tool-error` content parts so the model can react in multi-step loops
Find them in `result.steps`, e.g. `step.content.filter(part => part.type === 'tool-error')`, with `toolName`, `input` and `error`
generateText does throw for other tool errors such as `NoSuchToolError` or `InvalidToolInputError`
In streamText, they appear as `tool-error` parts in the stream

items.input: I have about 50 tools defined but want the model to see only a few of them in a given call. How do I do that?
reference: Pass `activeTools` with the names of the tools to expose; by default all tools are active
It keeps static typing for the full tool set while limiting what the model sees
`prepareStep` can change `activeTools` per step

items.input: What is the maximum number of tools I can pass to generateText?
reference: The docs give no fixed limit; they only say models can handle a limited number of tools depending on the model. The bot may suggest `activeTools` but must not invent a number

items.input: What is the default timeout for an MCP tool call in the AI SDK?
reference: The docs don't state a default timeout; requests accept an optional `timeout` in their request options. The bot must not invent a value or borrow unrelated numbers (e.g. the elicitation retry limit or delay)
